ns2:course.label: Survey of Latin Literature
ns2:course.description: Intermediate level readings in classical Latin literature. 3 undergraduate hours. 2 graduate hours. May be repeated for a total of 6 undergraduate hours or 4 graduate hours in separate semesters, if topics vary. Prerequisite: LAT 104 or four years of high school Latin.
